description:
*“I heard you were a Beta, but you're an Omega?”*

Peace, whose surname changed three times—from Seo Peace to Yoon Peace to Lee Peace—due to his famous actress mother's free-spirited nature, leaves home ahead of his mother's remarriage. With nothing but the beautiful face inherited from his mother, he hides his traits and barely scrapes by doing dating part-time jobs through a rental app. One day, he gets matched with a mysterious man who called for a Beta and there he encounters none other than Lee Tae-Kang, the son of her mother's prospective new husband. Is this match a coincidence or fate?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
